ابتدهن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَدَهْنَ (ibtadahna) /ib.ta.dah.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# اُبْتُدِهْنَ (ubtudihna) /ub.tu.dih.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# اِبْتَدِهْنَ (ibtadihna) /ib.ta.dih.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
